opennyai_summary.PREAMBLE:
Shaik Nayab Rasool, vs State Of Ap on 6 August, 2019
Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
Criminal Petition No.4677 of 2019
Order:
opennyai_summary.facts:
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against them, in FIR No.98 of 2019, on the file of Ongole Taluka Police Station, Prakasam District.
The offences alleged are under Sections 188, 273, 420 IPC and under Sections 58, 29 and 63 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.
In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in FIR No.98 of 2019, on the file of Ongole Taluka Police Station, Prakasam District, for the offences under Sections 188, 273, 420 IPC and under Sections 58, 29 and 63 of Food Safety and Standard Act-2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
